task_description: Provider activation flow across findu-spring-security (state machine + 4 validations + profile exposure + events), findu-help-v2 (idempotent provider-review ticket), findu-notification-processor (template seed + alert read endpoint), findu-core (write-once frontal photo), and the Flutter app findu_proveedores (BiometricVerifier abstraction + mock, register wizard, profile 'no activo' banner + INFO alerts + realtime). Reactive/hexagonal/Lombok; additive idempotent Postgres migration that does not break Railway qa; no Railway deploy or real AWS writes.
